versions.name: Occoneechee Scout Reservation
versions.summary: The Occoneechee Council's scout reservation in Moore County near Carthage, North Carolina, a wooded property that encompasses the developed Camp Durant and the more primitive Camp Reeves for year-round Scouts BSA and Cub Scout camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Occoneechee Council camping page at ocscouts.org, which lists Camp Durant and Camp Reeves within the reservation. The source placed the pin near Rougemont; the reservation is in Moore County near Carthage. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: reservation (umbrella of Camp Durant and Camp Reeves) verified against the council's own camping page; camp_type reservation; program_types classified conservatively; features unsurveyed.
